_readme: Metadata for config/chess_rules.json (type, unit, range, meaning). Paths use * as a wildcard for list indices ([*]) and for names. The loader checks every value against this; docs/game/RULES_REFERENCE.md is generated from it.

schema.doc: File format version. Do not change.

time_controls[*].label.doc: Name shown in the time-control list.

time_controls[*].increment_ms.doc: Time added after every move (Fischer increment).

computer_levels.*.name.doc: Name of the computer level shown in the UI.

computer_levels.*.max_depth.doc: Deepest search the engine may reach (ply = one half-move).

computer_levels.*.node_limit.doc: Search stops after this many positions (makes the level deterministic).

computer_levels.*.time_ms.doc: Wall-clock thinking budget per move (scaled on slow devices).

computer_levels.*.noise.doc: Random noise added to move scores (weaker levels play looser).

computer_levels.*.margin.doc: Moves within this score margin of the best may be picked instead.

computer_levels.*.blunder.doc: Chance that the level deliberately plays a weaker move.

computer_levels.*.skill.doc: Duel skill used when this level fights in Battle Chess.

computer_levels.*.style.doc: Duel style for defence: balanced, defensive, aggressive or duelist.

duel_ai_levels.*.label.doc: Name of the duel AI level (Easy, Normal, Hard, Expert).

duel_ai_levels.*.summary.doc: One-line description shown to the player.

duel_ai_levels.*.params.react_extra.doc: Extra reaction delay (higher = slower to react).

duel_ai_levels.*.params.error_rate.doc: Chance of a mistimed or wrong action.

duel_ai_levels.*.params.follow_chance.doc: Chance to follow up with the next hit of a combo.

duel_ai_levels.*.params.follow_max.doc: Longest combo the bot will attempt.

duel_ai_levels.*.params.heavy_chance.doc: Chance to use a heavy attack when an opening appears.

duel_ai_levels.*.params.defence_scale.doc: How often the bot defends (1 = baseline).

duel_ai_levels.*.params.cooldown_scale.doc: Scales the pause between the bot's actions (higher = slower).

duel_ai_levels.*.params.poke.doc: How often the bot pokes at range.

duel_ai_levels.*.params.hold_extra.doc: Extra time the bot holds a block or heavy charge.

battle_ai.fight_value.*.doc: Value the chess computer gives a piece when it fights a Battle Chess duel.

battle_ai.tier.*.doc: Strength tier used to estimate who wins a duel (higher = stronger).

royal.piece_values.*.doc: Order value of a piece in King's last stand (smaller defends first).

campaign.start_lives.doc: Lives at the start of a campaign run.

campaign.max_boon_stack.doc: How many times the same boon may be taken in one run.

campaign.boon_offer_size.doc: How many boons are offered after a win.

campaign.level_by_encounter[*].doc: AI level (easy, normal, hard, expert) of each of the 12 encounters, in order.

campaign.boons.*.text.doc: Boon description shown to the player (keep it in line with the numbers).

training.combo_window_ticks.doc: Time allowed between hits for them to count as a combo.

training.default_counter_window_ticks.doc: Default time to counter-attack after a parry or block in a lesson.

training.whiff_punish_window_ticks.doc: Time to punish an opponent's missed attack.

training.max_lesson_ticks.doc: Hard time limit of any lesson.
